canvasFindings: W010 (nnxyz nifty faces #40): The corrected white-canvas image reveals a white ground, not the dark or neutral ground implied by the earlier description. The face is densely packed with multicolored short strokes — magenta, cyan, red, yellow, orange — visible throughout the entire composition including the margins. The eye sockets contain rounded squares with cross marks, and the surrounding field is a riot of overlapping colored dashes and scribbles extending to the canvas edge, with no dark suppression of those marks. The mouth zone shows wide rounded tooth shapes in white with colored underlayers visible. The description of 'white ground' was correct in the existing prose, but the characterization of 'short color strokes' understated the chromatic intensity: the corrected image shows the full spectrum of dense multicolored marks radiating across the whole canvas, not merely packed between black scaffolding. The black scaffolding is present but the colored strokes are equally dominant and highly saturated, not subordinate to the black structure.

W123 (nnxyz nifty faces #14): The corrected white-canvas image shows a saturated yellow ground filling the entire canvas. The face interior is densely packed with multicolored scribbles — magenta, purple, teal, green, red — far more chromatic and visually complex than 'steep diagonal black lines over the eyes' suggests. The eye rectangles contain layered colored marks with small dark spiral centers, not simply diagonal hatching. The mouth bar is a white horizontal rectangle with sparse black tick marks, clearly sealed and pale against the surrounding color density. The overall field is extremely busy with looping white lines in the yellow margins and dense colored scribbles filling the face mass. The prior description emphasized black diagonal lines as the dominant feature, but the corrected image shows the face interior is primarily a dense multicolored scribble field, with the yellow ground and white mouth bar as the clearest structural anchors. The transition description referencing 'steep diagonal hatching' and 'no opening' also needs revision to reflect the actual chromatic density visible.

title: Faces Built from Boxes
question: How do rectangular eye sockets and mouth shapes organize a face?
introduction: Rectangular frames divide these faces into eye zones, brow bands and mouths. Follow those divisions through flat color areas and increasingly layered lines, then compare works whose compartments are less easy to separate. The rectangles remain useful landmarks even when curved and diagonal marks cross them. Which shapes make recognition possible?
closing: Return to an eye socket or mouth in an earlier work. Does its rectangular frame make the feature clearer, or draw attention to the marks crossing it?

chapters.title: The Basic Grammar
chapters.introduction: Three works establish the core structure: a face divided into hard-edged zones, each feature assigned its own rectangular compartment with a distinct interior.

stops.whyHere: The exhibition's threshold: a face framed by a rust-orange inner line and a blue outer line, eyes spiked and glowing amber inside rigid frames, mouth a row of white vertical bars — the locked structure stated plainly.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #63

stops.whyHere: X-marked eye rectangles and stacked horizontal bars echo nnxyz nifty faces #63's locked zones, but a flat blue ground and zigzag edges hold the whole structure at a cooler, more diagrammatic remove.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Where nnxyz nifty faces #63 glows warm amber inside a dark teal field, here a flat blue ground and crossed-out eyes push the constructed face toward something colder and more schematic.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #46

stops.whyHere: Stacked eye blocks and a wide tooth bar repeat the compartment logic, but a jagged sawtooth crown and loose white lines crossing every boundary introduce the first visible signs of instability.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The X-eyes of nnxyz nifty faces #46 are replaced by banded rectangles, and the purple field gives the structure a heavier ceremonial weight, while the sawtooth crown breaks the strict containment nnxyz nifty faces #46 maintained.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #97

chapters.title: Flat Grounds, Direct Address
chapters.introduction: Four works place the rectangular face against a single saturated color, removing spatial depth and pushing the assembled features into unmediated contact with the viewer.

stops.whyHere: Red X eyes in white squares on a burnt-orange field: the flattest, most emblem-like face so far, every mark locked inside its block with almost no marks escaping the boundary.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nifty faces #97's loose white lines crossing its boundaries are absent here; nnxyz nifty faces #96 returns to strict containment, the orange ground pressing everything flush against the picture plane.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #96

stops.whyHere: The same orange field as nnxyz nifty faces #96, but crosshatched rectangles replace the bold X eyes, and white scribble lines begin to radiate beyond the face outline, introducing surface restlessness.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Both share a flat orange ground and sealed eye rectangles, but nnxyz nifty faces #70's crosshatching and radiating scribbles introduce a restlessness that nnxyz nifty faces #96's clean X marks suppress.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #70

stops.whyHere: Acid yellow-green replaces orange; the left eye box holds a red X while the right holds a horizontal bar, giving the face a slightly asymmetric locked quality, and loose jagged lines now scatter across the entire field.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nifty faces #70's scribbles stayed near the head; here the loose lines cover the whole yellow-green field, making the rigid face structure feel surrounded rather than simply decorated.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #106

stops.whyHere: A saturated yellow ground fills the canvas edge to edge, and the face interior is a dense mass of multicolored scribbles — magenta, purple, teal, green, red — with looping white lines circling through the yellow margins. The eye rectangles hold layered colored marks converging on small dark spiral centers, and the mouth is a sealed white horizontal bar with sparse black tick marks: the one clear pause in an otherwise unrelenting chromatic density.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nifty faces #106's loose lines spread across a yellow-green field; nnxyz nifty faces #14 replaces that open scatter with a compressed mass of multicolored scribbles packed tightly into the face volume, the yellow ground pressing in from every edge while the white mouth bar holds as the sole uncluttered zone.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #14

chapters.title: Compartments at Capacity
chapters.introduction: Five works fill each rectangular zone with competing marks — crossed lines, spirals, packed strokes — until the interior of every compartment is working against its own boundary.

stops.whyHere: White ovals crossed by red horizontal bars in each eye box, triangular teeth in the mouth zone: compartments packed with competing strokes, each mark holding its brightness against the surrounding noise.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nifty faces #14's diagonal lines compressed the surface inward; nnxyz nifty faces #39 opens the color back up, filling each rectangular zone with layered strokes rather than a single dominant mark.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #39

stops.whyHere: Spiral eye zones pull attention inward while the mouth's packed crosshatch reads as noise against the open teal ground, which gives the density room the darker fields denied.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nifty faces #39's eye marks were flat ovals with horizontal bars; nnxyz nifty faces #54 replaces them with tight concentric spirals, adding a centripetal pull the earlier work's horizontal marks refused.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #54

stops.whyHere: Dense crossing lines fill the eye areas until they read as texture rather than gaze; the compressed mid-face leaves almost no gap between the stacked zones.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nifty faces #54's spirals still read as eyes; nnxyz nifty faces #101 fills its eye boxes so densely with crossing lines that any sense of a directed gaze dissolves into pattern.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #101

stops.whyHere: Cross marks inside rounded-square eye sockets anchor the compartment logic, but the corrected image reveals the entire canvas — face and margins alike — filled with dense, equally weighted multicolored strokes in magenta, cyan, red, yellow and orange, all reading at full saturation against the white ground. The black scaffolding organizes the zones without suppressing the chromatic field around it, making this the most chromatically pressurized face in the chapter.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nifty faces #101's density was built from crossing lines alone; nnxyz nifty faces #40 replaces that linear accumulation with a full-spectrum field of short colored strokes — magenta, cyan, red, yellow, orange — packed across every zone and into the margins, so the interior pressure is chromatic rather than purely linear.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #40

stops.whyHere: Zigzag brow bands, stacked rectangles crowding the eye zone, a row of white rounded blocks as a lower jaw: the face reads as a stage set, each zone a separate scene framed top and bottom.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nifty faces #40's compartments were tightly sealed on a white ground; nnxyz nifty faces #53 opens the composition vertically, the striped top and tooth-row bottom framing the dense center like a proscenium arch.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #53

chapters.title: Scaffolding Made Visible
chapters.introduction: Four works pull back from maximum density toward a structural, diagrammatic quality: the face reads as a plan or diagram rather than a presence, and the scaffolding itself becomes the subject.

stops.whyHere: Spring coils bracket the sides, cross-marked ovals sit inside nested rectangles, and the white ground makes the structural logic fully legible — the face as mechanical diagram.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nifty faces #53's stage-set density gives way to nnxyz nifty faces #51's white ground, where the stacked rectangular logic is most exposed and the coil lines at each side make the compression literal.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #51

stops.whyHere: Yellow scaffolding frames a grid of smaller rectangles; three spirals pull inward at different depths while a zigzag mouth band sits flat and wide — diagram and vortex held in the same image.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nifty faces #51's spring coils suggested compression from outside the face; nnxyz nifty faces #35 internalises that energy as spirals nested within the yellow frame, pulling inward rather than pressing in from the sides.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #35

stops.whyHere: Three stacked rectangles build a face as compartments: spiral eyes above, a pale loosely scratched mouth below, hot pink and dark maroon pulling the mood in opposite directions across the surface.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nifty faces #35's spirals were symmetrically placed within a centred yellow frame; nnxyz nifty faces #31 shifts the weight to one side with heavy magenta hatching on the right edge, breaking the bilateral calm.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #31

stops.whyHere: A round face outline breaks the rectangular rule, but the interior is still divided into eye boxes with crossed-circle marks and a scalloped tooth border — the compartment logic persisting inside a curved boundary.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nifty faces #31's tall rectangular form gives way to a round outline, a visible contrast in silhouette, yet the same bilateral eye-box symmetry and tooth border hold the face to the same constructed logic.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #80

chapters.title: The Frame Under Strain
chapters.introduction: The final two works push the rectangular structure to its limit: marks escape their zones, labels appear on the grid, and the geometry reads as something it can no longer fully organize.

stops.whyHere: Three labeled eye-boxes spelling X, Y, Z make the grid literal; double stacked mouth rectangles and loose lines leaking past the lavender field push the schematic face to its most explicit and unstable form.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nifty faces #80's crossed-circle eye marks were ambiguous; nnxyz nifty faces #76 replaces ambiguity with legible letters, turning each eye zone into a labeled grid cell and making the face's constructed logic impossible to overlook.
stops.title: nnxyz nifty faces #76
